failure_summary.description: Trajectories bypassed compatible cached results, failed to filter or save results correctly, or used inconsistent cache/result handling.
Round-trip requests were represented as a single flight search with an arrival date instead of separate outbound and return searches.
State abbreviations or airport identifiers were assigned to the wrong search fields.
A hotel search added an unprovided party size and did not use adjust_date for the explicit stay length.

patch.reasoning: The recurring failures are already explicitly addressed by the cache workflow, field-mapping guidance, flight-leg rules, and required-argument checks. Adding more instructions would duplicate existing skill content rather than patch a gap.
